entities.body: Hermes has no working complexity-based routing natively (smart_model_routing is an accepted-but-unimplemented config key per upstream issue tracker; delegation.model only sets one global model for all subagents). Built scripts/complexity_router.py, an OpenAI-compatible proxy that classifies the latest user message with a keyword/length/code-block heuristic, forwards simple prompts to Ollama directly, and deliberately returns 503 for complex ones so Hermes real, working fallback_model mechanism (built for rate-limits/errors) auto-escalates to Codex - avoids reimplementing Codex OAuth. Deployed as systemd service complexity-router.service on hermes-vps (127.0.0.1:11500), wired in via providers.ollama.base_url and model.base_url. Verified end-to-end via real hermes chat calls: simple prompt stayed on Ollama, complex prompt produced log line "Switched to fallback model: qwen3-vl:8b-hermes via custom -> gpt-5.6-sol via openai-codex" and Codex correctly asked for repo/logs/repro before proceeding.

Added looks_inadequate() checking Ollama actual response content for: empty, refusal-language patterns, finish_reason=length (truncation), and degenerate n-gram repetition. Requires buffering the full upstream response before relaying (forces stream:false to Ollama regardless of what Hermes requested, then repackages as SSE chunks if Hermes wanted streaming) - loses live token-by-token display on the simple path in exchange for this safety net; total wait time unaffected. entities.body: User correctly rejected cold-load speculation and demanded real data. Added timing/token logging to complexity_router.py. Found: Hermes sends a ~14,724-token system prompt on every turn (10 MCP tools + built-ins + SOUL.md/memory), dwarfing any actual question. Ollama does prompt-prefix caching - a warm cache hit reused 14,715 of 14,724 tokens (99.9%), dropping a repeat trivial question to 6-11s total. The 93s outlier happened because Ollamas default keep_alive (5 min) evicts both the model from VRAM AND the prompt cache after any idle gap, so the next request pays full model-reload plus full 14.7K-token cold prefill simultaneously. Fixed by setting OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=24h (Machine-level env var) and restarting the service.

entities.body: Root cause of wildly inconsistent completion-token counts (169 to 2413 for equally trivial questions) is a confirmed upstream Ollama bug: github.com/ollama/ollama#14798 - qwen3-vl:8b ships with a bare {{ .Prompt }} template missing the thinking-control logic that plain qwen3 has, so the standard think:false API parameter is silently ignored. Tested and deployed a workaround: appending a literal /nothink to the users message (a trained-behavior effect independent of the broken template). Measured consistently: 337-371 tokens with /nothink vs 169-2413 without across repeated identical-difficulty questions - does not eliminate thinking entirely but cuts average verbosity roughly in half and dramatically reduces variance. Added append_nothink() to complexity_router.py, applied automatically to every request forwarded to Ollama.
